passages.note: Bill overview page lists Willoughby as prime sponsor of HB2332, signed by the governor 2025-05-13.

The enacted text requires the health department to compile and distribute maternal mental health/postpartum depression educational materials and creates a rural maternal-health advisory committee to develop recommendations and submit a report, rather than setting who government covers or helps pay for care.
House Final Reading vote on HB2332 shows Willoughby voting Y on the same information/advisory-committee measure.

rows.reasoning: HB 2332 (2025), which Willoughby prime-sponsored and voted Y on and which the governor signed 2025-05-13, directs the health department to distribute postpartum depression educational materials and creates a rural maternal-health advisory committee to develop recommendations and report; per the annex's 'Health information is not access' rule, a measure that distributes health information or orders a study committee does not say whom government covers or helps pay for care, so no passage establishes any rung of 'What role should government play in healthcare access?'
